Jet Ski Rentals in St. Petersburg, FL

Check Availability & Book
📞 Call Now

                                                                                                     ★★★★★ Rated 5.0 on Google by 610+ Riders

Check Availability & Book Your Jet Ski Rental in St. Petersburg, FL

Don’t just visit the Gulf Coast — ride it. Secure your WaveRunner now and explore Shell Key, Egmont Key, Fort De Soto, and open Gulf waters with total freedom.

✔ Instant online booking
✔ Real-time availability
✔ No hidden fees
✔ Fast check-in process

Why Riders Choose Xtreme Jet Ski Watersports

Premium equipment. Transparent pricing. Prime Gulf access.

Brand New Yamaha WaveRunners
Ride Brand New Yamaha Wave Runners built for power, control, and comfort. Smooth handling, strong acceleration, Bluetooth audio, and beginner-friendly operation.

Launch Directly Into Open Gulf Waters
No long idle zones. No crowded canals. Immediate access to Fort De Soto, Shell Key Preserve, Egmont Key, and wildlife-rich coastal waters.

No Hidden Fees — Ever
Transparent pricing. What you see at checkout is exactly what you pay. No surprise add-ons. No last-minute charges.

What to Expect on Your Ride

After a quick safety orientation, you’re free to cruise open water, carve through smooth Gulf swells, or follow scenic coastal routes. Spot dolphins, explore sandbars, and experience St. Petersburg from the water — the way it’s meant to be seen.

Perfect for couples, families, first-timers, and thrill-seekers alike.

Before You Book

  • Minimum driver age: 18

  • Boater safety course required if born after January 1, 1988

  • Valid government-issued ID required ( Photo Passport also Valid for International guests)

  • Please arrive 20–30 minutes early

  • Weather policy: Full refund or easy reschedule if conditions are unsafe

⚠️ Limited Availability During Peak Season

Weekend, holiday, and spring break time slots sell out quickly — especially midday rides.

If your preferred time is available right now, we recommend securing it immediately. Once a slot fills, it’s gone.

Ready to Ride?

Check real-time availability below and lock in your jet ski rental before spots fill.
